messages.content: "emotional cheating" ei jinista actually ki, physical na hoile o counts kore?

Onek relationship e eta e counts kore, hae. Jodi kono connection secretly build hocche ja tumi partner theke hide korcho, ar emotionally invest korcho onno jaygay - eta already boundary cross kora, physical na hoyeo. Ei line ta manush surprisingly onek somoy miss kore jai.
